# The gleif pack

*GLEIF legal entities* · version 1.0.0 · code `GLEIF`

## What it is

Legal Entity Identifiers and who owns whom, from GLEIF: the ownership groups of the us-equities companies with an LEI and of the
large financial institutions (the FSB's G-SIBs, other large banks, insurers, asset managers and market infrastructures), each the
ultimate parent with the entities it consolidates, at most 50 a group, the nearest levels first. Every entity carries its addresses,
registration and renewal (late renewals flagged), its parents chain, its children and its BICs and ISIN count. Off by default; with
us-equities on, a company and its LEI record link both ways.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `lei-entity`

**LEI legal entity** · mnemonic `LEI`.

**Id:** field `LEI`; pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`; for example `0292001381F1R1IB5B85`.

Fields, from 4000 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | string | `0292001381F1R1IB5B85` | Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442, 20 characters) |
| `NAME` | string | `STANBIC IBTC STOCKBROKERS LIMITED` | Legal name |
| `LEGAL_FORM` | string | `Public company limited by shares` | Legal form (the ELF code's name) |
| `LEI_COUNTRY` | string | `NG` | Country of the legal address (ISO 3166 alpha-2), a link to its lei-country; link to `lei-country` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | `Nigeria` | The country's name |
| `LEGAL_ADDRESS` | string | `IBTC PLACE, WALTER CARRINGTON CRESCENT, …` | Legal address |
| `LEGAL_CITY` | string | `LAGOS` | City of the legal address |
| `REGISTERED_AS` | string | `85776` | Number at the business register (in 98%) |
| `ENTITY_STATUS` | string | `ACTIVE` | Entity status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE) |
| `CREATED` | date | `1986-06-26` | Date the entity was created (in 92%) |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | string | `ISSUED` | LEI registration status (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, ...) |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date | `2016-07-14` | First registration of the LEI |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date | `2026-07-27` | Last update of the record |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date | `2027-07-13` | Next renewal date |
| `RENEWAL_LATE` | boolean | `false` | True when the registration lapsed or its renewal date has passed |
| `MANAGING_LOU` | string | `Central Securities Clearing System PLC` | The LEI issuer (LOU) managing the record |
| `BICS` | string | `STIKNGL2XXX` | Its BICs (GLEIF mapping file) (in 10%) |
| `BIC_COUNT` | integer | `1` | Number of BICs (in 10%) |
| `DIRECT_PARENT` | string | `2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41` | Direct accounting consolidation parent's LEI; link to `lei-entity` (in 81%) |
| `LEI_GROUP` | string | `2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41` | The ownership group (its ultimate parent's LEI); link to `lei-group` |
| `PARENTS` | list of objects |  | The parents chain, direct parent first (in 97%) |
| `ISIN_COUNT` | integer | `2` | Number of ISINs mapped to it (GLEIF mapping file) (in 9%) |
| `ULTIMATE_PARENT` | string | `2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41` | Ultimate parent's LEI, when it differs from the direct parent; link to `lei-entity` (in 35%) |
| `CHILDREN` | list of objects |  | Entities it directly consolidates, in the pack (in 8%) |
| `CHILD_COUNT` | integer | `1` | Number of children in the pack (in 8%) |
| `DIRECT_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | `1` | Number of direct children in GLEIF (in 11%) |
| `OTHER_NAMES` | list of objects |  | Other and previous names, with their type (in 31%) |
| `RENEWAL` | string | `Due in 12 days (2026-11-05)` | What the renewal says, when late or due within 30 days (in 22%) |
| `OPENCORPORATES` | string | `nl/34153487` | OpenCorporates company id (in 40%) |
| `JURISDICTION` | string | `US-DE` | Legal jurisdiction when it differs from the country (in 20%) |
| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS` | list of objects |  | Reporting exceptions (why no parent is reported) (in 18%) |
| `ULTIMATE_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | `9` | Number of entities naming it ultimate parent in GLEIF (in 3%) |
| `MAPPING_IDS` | list of strings |  | Its identifier documents (lei-mapping); link to `lei-mapping` (in 3%) |
| `SEGMENT` | string | `US equities` | Why it is a seed (US equities, G-SIB, bank, insurer, asset manager, market infrastructure) (in 3%) |
| `US_COMPANY` | string | `WAB` | The us-equities company's ticker, a link to it (in 2%) |
| `US_COMPANY_NAME` | string | `Wabtec` | The us-equities company's name (in 2%) |
| `HQ_ADDRESS` | string | `1 Riverside Plaza, 43215 Columbus, US-OH…` | Headquarters address, when it differs from the legal address (in 32%) |
| `HQ_COUNTRY` | string | `US` | Headquarters country, when it differs (in 5%) |
| `MIC` | string | `MAQI` | Market identifier codes it operates (in 1%) |
| `CATEGORY` | string | `Fund` | Entity category when not general (fund, branch, sole proprietor) (in 3%) |
| `SUCCESSOR` | string | `724500ZSA7ZOZHUXBS53` | Successor entity's LEI; link to `lei-entity` (in 0%) |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `PARENTS[]` | `LEVEL` (integer), `LEI` (string), `NAME` (string), `RELATIONSHIP` (string) |
| `CHILDREN[]` | `LEI` (string), `NAME` (string), `COUNTRY` (string), `KIDS` (integer) |
| `OTHER_NAMES[]` | `NAME` (string), `TYPE` (string) |
| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS[]` | `LEVEL` (string), `REASON` (string), `MEANING` (string) |

Links: `DIRECT_PARENT` → `lei-entity`, `LEI_COUNTRY` → `lei-country`, `LEI_GROUP` → `lei-group`, `MAPPING_IDS` → `lei-mapping`, `SUCCESSOR` → `lei-entity`, `ULTIMATE_PARENT` → `lei-entity`.

### `lei-relationship`

**LEI parent relationship** · mnemonic `LEIR`.

**Id:** field `RELATIONSHIP_ID`; pattern `^LEIREL-`; for example `LEIREL-0292001381F1R1IB5B85-DIRECT`.

Fields, from 4000 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | string | `LEIREL-0292001381F1R1IB5B85-DIRECT` | LEIREL-<child LEI>-DIRECT or -ULTIMATE |
| `LEVEL` | string | `Direct` | Direct or Ultimate |
| `CHILD_ENTITY` | string | `0292001381F1R1IB5B85` | The child's LEI; link to `lei-entity` |
| `PARENT_ENTITY` | string | `2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41` | The parent's LEI; link to `lei-entity` |
| `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS` | string | `ACTIVE` | ACTIVE or INACTIVE |
| `START` | date | `2006-01-25` | Start of the relationship |
| `PERIODS` | list of objects |  | Accounting and document filing periods |
| `ACCOUNTING_STANDARD` | string | `IFRS` | Accounting standard of the consolidation (in 50%) |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | string | `PUBLISHED` | The relationship record's registration status |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date | `2016-07-14` | First registered |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date | `2026-07-27` | Last updated |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date | `2027-07-13` | Next renewal |
| `LEI_GROUP` | string | `2549003PEZXUT7MDBU41` | link to `lei-group` |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `PERIODS[]` | `TYPE` (string), `START` (date), `END` (date) |

Links: `CHILD_ENTITY` → `lei-entity`, `LEI_GROUP` → `lei-group`, `PARENT_ENTITY` → `lei-entity`.

## Screens and commands

| Command | Kind | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | `lei-entity` | LEI legal entity |
| `LEIG` | `lei-group` | LEI ownership group |
| `LEIR` | `lei-relationship` | LEI parent relationship |
| `LEIC` | `lei-country` | LEI country |
| `LEIM` | `lei-mapping` | ISIN or BIC to LEI |
| `GLEIF` | — | The pack's overview: its kinds, how many each holds, an example of each |

Examples:

| Type | Shows |
|---|---|
| `LEI 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748` | JPMorgan Chase & Co. · parents, children (a click opens one beside), identifiers, the listed company |
| `LEI HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394` | Apple Inc. · its LEI record and the us-equities company |
| `LEIG 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748` | JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s ownership group · the tree, counts by country and legal form |
| `LEIG MLU0ZO3ML4LN2LL2TL39` | HSBC Holdings · a global bank's group |
| `LEIG ALL` | Every ownership group, and a search of the entities |
| `LEIC GB` | United Kingdom · the entities with a British legal address |
| `LEIC ALL` | Every country of the entities |

Screens (Sutras):

| Sutra | Kind | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `lei-browse` | `lei-group` | Search and browse the pack's legal entities: a search box over every entity, every ownership group, groups by segment and entities by country. |
| `lei-countries` | `lei-country` | Every country of the pack's legal entities, by the number of entities. |
| `lei-country` | `lei-country` | A country's legal entities in the pack: the entities, the groups present, legal forms and cities. |
| `lei-entity` | `lei-entity` | A legal entity from its LEI record: key facts, addresses, registration and renewal, parents, children and identifiers. |
| `lei-group` | `lei-group` | An ownership group: the ultimate parent with its whole tree, every member, and counts by country and legal form. |
| `lei-mapping` | `lei-mapping` | An ISIN, BIC or MIC and the legal entity GLEIF's mapping files give it. |
| `lei-relationship` | `lei-relationship` | One consolidation relationship from GLEIF's level 2 data: the child, its direct or ultimate parent, status and periods. |

## Data sources and licences

Everything GLEIF publishes is CC0 1.0: free of charge, no restriction; attribution is appreciated ("Source: GLEIF, LEI data").
The groups use the consolidation relationships only; fund management, sub-fund, feeder and branch relationships are left out.

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| GLEIF golden copy, level 2 (relationship records, reporting exceptions) | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | who consolidates whom (direct and ultimate parents), relationship periods and status, why a parent is not reported |
| GLEIF LEI API (lei-records, entity-legal-forms, countries, lei-issuers) | CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated) | no | each entity's level 1 record, legal form names, country names, LOU names |
| GLEIF mapping files (BIC, ISIN, MIC, OpenCorporates to LEI) | CC0 1.0 (the BIC file with SWIFT, the ISIN file with ANNA) | no | the identifiers of the entities |
| GLEIF golden copy, level 1 bulk file | CC0 1.0 | no | full-country pulls into the data folder only (golden-lei source; never committed, for its size) |

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on no other pack.

## Refreshing the data

`python3 tools/publicdata/gleif.py status` shows what the pack holds and how old it is; `refresh` fetches, rebuilds and checks (docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md).

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/gleif/make.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
